prompt: Revise this customer message to acknowledge the problem without promising an uncertain result: 'Your parcel has not arrived. We have asked the delivery service to investigate. They have not yet given a date. We will send another update by Friday even if the investigation is unfinished.' A response of around 120 words is enough.
text: We’re sorry that your parcel has not arrived and understand how frustrating this is. We have asked the delivery service to investigate its whereabouts, but they have not yet provided an expected delivery date or confirmed what happened. We do not want to give you an inaccurate estimate while their investigation is ongoing. We will contact you again by Friday with the latest information available, even if the investigation has not yet been completed. At that point, we will explain any further steps we can take and continue to keep you informed as more details become available. Thank you for your patience while we work with the delivery service to clarify the situation.
